intro: Pipe fittings are tools that help connect pipes in piping systems. They can also be employed to change or reduce the flow. These fittings help connect pipes of different shapes and sizes and complete the piping system. Some of the most common pipe fittings are elbow, reducer, tee, union, caps, valves, etc. Over the last decade, we have been the leading Pipe Fittings manufacturers in India. We ensure that the products we produce are top quality and available at reasonable rates to all.

The buttweld pipe fittings are the most versatile way of welding a pipe. This joint is formed by placing two pieces of metal on each end and welding it. These pipes are important in the industrial setting. These pipes are sold in nominal pipe sizes with a respective schedule. The seamless buttweld pipe fittings are made up of one piece and have no combined pieces. These fittings are extremely corrosion resistant as well as show high resistance to extreme temperatures. These fittings are made by either cold or hot rolling them. We manufacture all our products under strict supervision from our experienced and knowledgeable team members. Our team members use the best raw materials using the best technology following international and national standards.

If you are looking for fittings to handle heavy-duty applications, then the Schedule 40 Buttweld Fittings will do your bidding. The smooth interior of this fitting makes it resistant to corrosion and safe from the wrath of nature. We are one of the only weld pipe fittings manufacturer that help customize all your fittings in different shapes and sizes as per your requirements. description: Stainless steel is a versatile material, which is made up of steel alloy and chromium. The composition of chromium along with a few other alloys makes stainless pipe fittings resistant to corrosion, oxidation, high temperatures, and sub-zero temperatures. As a result, stainless steel pipes have wide spread applications in textile, chemical, dairy, food processing, power plants, oil and gas processing, and many other related fields. We are the leading producers of Stainless Steel Pipe Fittings manufacturers in India. Our main aim is to produce the best products, which are available to all at reasonable rates.

The ASME B16.9 SS Elbow is a standard elbow, which connects all stainless steel pipes to change their direction of flow. The SS Long Radius Elbow is the most popular elbow to change the direction of flow in pipes. These elbows are produced in many dimensions thereby, ensuring a tight seal to prevent any leakage. These elbows are available in different shapes, dimensions and can be customized to fit any stainless steel pipe. An ASME B16.9 Stainless Steel Stub Endcoexists with a backing flange. A stainless steel stub end has one flared end and one square cut end, which is welded to another pipe of the same size.

The schedule 10 stainless steel pipe fittings are thicker than normal outer diameter pipes. This makes them the perfect choice for custom fabrication and turbo manifolds. The thick walls make it resistant to thermal stress in boilers, condensers, and heat exchangers. Our renowned workers also produce the ASTM A403 Buttweld Fitting by bevelling each end of a valve to match an opening in the pipe. The two ends are then butted to the pipe and welded together.

The SS 304L Weld Fitting is resistant to corrosion and can be welded onto pipes or valves in any environment without the requirement of annealing. Due to their versatility, these fittings are used in beer brewing, winemaking, construction, chemical, mining industries, etc. We are one of the top manufacturers and distributors of stainless steel 304L Pipe Fittings, our main focus is creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

The ASTM A403 WP304L Elbow is an austenitic stainless steel fitting for different pressure piping applications. Our workers use bars, plates, or seamless or welded tubular products to produce it. These elbows can be customized into different shapes and sizes as per your requirements. The WNR 1.4306 Short Radius Elbow radius is equal to the nominal size of the tube. These short radius elbows are frequently used for applications that require movement of low pressure fluids. Our experienced crew ensures that we use the best raw materials while preparing the best products with the latest technology.

The ANSI B16.9 UNS S30403 Reducer is used to connect a small pipe to a big pipe or vice versa. These reducers have good strong strength and ductile properties, which help them to be durable and resistant to corrosion and extreme temperatures. The A403 Gr.wp304l End Cap acts as a protective device for pipes. We follow international as well as national standards while manufacturing and supplying all our products. description: Stainless steel 316 is austenitic steel made up of chromium and nickel. These Stainless Steel 316 Pipe Fittings contain small amounts of molybdenum. The molybdenum concentration makes these fittings resistant to corrosion and pitting to chloride ion solutions. This Mo-added steel also has high resistance to extreme temperatures, as these fittings don’t deform under any pressure. These fittings are commonly used in construction, heaters, heat exchangers, evaporators, pulp, textile, and other related industries exposed to marine environments. We are proud to be the leading manufacturers of Stainless Steel 316 Pipe Fittings, and our ultimate aim is to produce high-quality products at reasonable rates.

The ASTM A403 WP316 Reducer is used to adapt to pipes of different sizes. These reducers are also in use when the flow of certain gases and fluids is increased or decreased. The UNS S31600 Reducing Tee has 3 openings of, which one is smaller compared to the other openings. This S31600 tee is mostly used in piping systems with a larger diameter as the dimension range is larger. We produce 316 Stainless Steel Weld Fittings in different shapes and dimensions as per our client’s requirements. Our renowned workers ensure that they use the best raw materials while carefully producing top-quality products using the latest technology.

The WNR 1.4401 Stub End has a flared end on the outside while the other size is welded to the pipe having the same normal pipe sizes. ASTM A403 WP316 End Cap is fitted to eliminate block lines in pump lines and valves. These end caps at as protective devices for pipes. If you have any queries regarding our products or pricing, contact us for more information.

316 tends to have more nickel and a bit of molybdenum in the mix then grade 304, addition of nickel and molybdenum makes grade 316 more expensive alloy then grade 304. Melting point of grade 304 stainless steel is a bit higher than that of grade 316, 316 has a better resistance to chemicals and chlorides then 304 stainless steel.

description: The 316L stainless steel is a lower version of 316 stainless steel alloy. The Stainless Steel 316L Pipe Fittings is a common austenitic steel alloy. With primary constituents of iron, chromium, nickel, and molybdenum, these fittings are highly resistant to corrosion and can suffice under extreme temperatures. The SS 316L Buttweld Pipe Fittings have excellent welding and forming properties. These low carbon steel fittings also have high tensile and yield strength. These marine-grade 316L fittings are commonly used in marine industries near seashores and urban areas. They are also seen in the petrochemical and food industries. We are the leading manufacturers and suppliers of Stainless Steel 316L Pipe Fittings. We consider it our moral obligation to produce high-quality products at reasonable rates.

The ASME SA 403 WP 316L Pipe Reducer is simply used to adapt to pipes of different sizes. It can be also used when the flow of fluids or gases is expanded or reduced. These pipe reducers can either be concentric or eccentric. For a nominal pipe size of 1mm, the UNS S31603 Reducer has 33.4mm as its outer diameter which can be reduced as per requirements. We manufacture all our products under strict supervision from our experienced and knowledgeable team members. Our team members use the best raw materials using the best technology following international and national standards.

The ASTM A403 WP316L Elbow has excellent hardness, formability, fatigue properties, and strength. This elbow is used to change the angle of flow in petrochemical, oil, gas, and other related industries. We also produce the A403 Gr Wp316l Stub End which, can be customized in different shapes and sizes as per your requirements. If you have any queries about our products, contact us.

description: Grade 321 stainless steel is an austenitic alloy with the addition of titanium. The Stainless Steel 321 Pipe Fittings is developed with intergranular corrosion resistance. These 321 fittings are resistant to sterilizing solutions, corrosion, chemical, and other inorganic chemicals. The addition of titanium reduces the carbide precipitation during welding. As a result, the UNS S32100 Buttweld Fitting has good welding and formability properties. These fittings are a good choice in high-temperature environments of 800 °F and 1650 °F. They are commonly used in exhausts, aircraft collector rings, and high-temperature chemical equipment. We are one of the top Stainless Steel 321 Pipe Fittings manufacturers in India who focus on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

The ASTM A403 WP321h Elbow is used to change the angle of flow in pipelines. These ASTM elbows are advantageous because of their good mechanical properties as well as good performance under extreme temperatures. The WNR NR. 1.4541 Fittings are mostly used in building and chemical industries. They are manufactured with higher creep and stress rupture properties compared to 304 alloys. Our experienced workers use the best raw materials and the latest technology to produce the best products.

The ASME SA 403 WP 321 Pipe Reducer is designed with increased wall thickness. These thick walls provide it more durability as well as resists cracking due to high thermal stress from exhaust gases or rising temperatures. These reducers can be either concentric or eccentric. We also produce the SA403 WP321 Tee, which can be customized into different shapes and sizes to fit pipes or valves of different dimensions. If you have any questions about our products or prices, contact us for more information.

description: Stainless steel 316 is austenitic steel made up of chromium and nickel. These Stainless Steel 316 Pipe Fittings contain small amounts of molybdenum. The molybdenum concentration makes these fittings resistant to corrosion and pitting to chloride ion solutions. This Mo-added steel also has high resistance to extreme temperatures, as these fittings don’t deform under any pressure. These fittings are commonly used in construction, heaters, heat exchangers, evaporators, pulp, textile, and other related industries exposed to marine environments. We are proud to be the leading manufacturers of Stainless Steel 316 Pipe Fittings, and our ultimate aim is to produce high-quality products at reasonable rates.

The ASTM A403 WP316 Reducer is used to adapt to pipes of different sizes. These reducers are also in use when the flow of certain gases and fluids is increased or decreased. The UNS S31600 Reducing Tee has 3 openings of, which one is smaller compared to the other openings. This S31600 tee is mostly used in piping systems with a larger diameter as the dimension range is larger. We produce 316 Stainless Steel Weld Fittings in different shapes and dimensions as per our client’s requirements. Our renowned workers ensure that they use the best raw materials while carefully producing top-quality products using the latest technology.

The WNR 1.4401 Stub End has a flared end on the outside while the other size is welded to the pipe having the same normal pipe sizes. ASTM A403 WP316 End Cap is fitted to eliminate block lines in pump lines and valves. These end caps at as protective devices for pipes. If you have any queries regarding our products or pricing, contact us for more information.

316 tends to have more nickel and a bit of molybdenum in the mix then grade 304, addition of nickel and molybdenum makes grade 316 more expensive alloy then grade 304. Melting point of grade 304 stainless steel is a bit higher than that of grade 316, 316 has a better resistance to chemicals and chlorides then 304 stainless steel.

description: The 316L stainless steel is a lower version of 316 stainless steel alloy. The Stainless Steel 316L Pipe Fittings is a common austenitic steel alloy. With primary constituents of iron, chromium, nickel, and molybdenum, these fittings are highly resistant to corrosion and can suffice under extreme temperatures. The SS 316L Buttweld Pipe Fittings have excellent welding and forming properties. These low carbon steel fittings also have high tensile and yield strength. These marine-grade 316L fittings are commonly used in marine industries near seashores and urban areas. They are also seen in the petrochemical and food industries. We are the leading manufacturers and suppliers of Stainless Steel 316L Pipe Fittings. We consider it our moral obligation to produce high-quality products at reasonable rates.

The ASME SA 403 WP 316L Pipe Reducer is simply used to adapt to pipes of different sizes. It can be also used when the flow of fluids or gases is expanded or reduced. These pipe reducers can either be concentric or eccentric. For a nominal pipe size of 1mm, the UNS S31603 Reducer has 33.4mm as its outer diameter which can be reduced as per requirements. We manufacture all our products under strict supervision from our experienced and knowledgeable team members. Our team members use the best raw materials using the best technology following international and national standards.

The ASTM A403 WP316L Elbow has excellent hardness, formability, fatigue properties, and strength. This elbow is used to change the angle of flow in petrochemical, oil, gas, and other related industries. We also produce the A403 Gr Wp316l Stub End which, can be customized in different shapes and sizes as per your requirements. If you have any queries about our products, contact us.

description: Grade 321 stainless steel is an austenitic alloy with the addition of titanium. The Stainless Steel 321 Pipe Fittings is developed with intergranular corrosion resistance. These 321 fittings are resistant to sterilizing solutions, corrosion, chemical, and other inorganic chemicals. The addition of titanium reduces the carbide precipitation during welding. As a result, the UNS S32100 Buttweld Fitting has good welding and formability properties. These fittings are a good choice in high-temperature environments of 800 °F and 1650 °F. They are commonly used in exhausts, aircraft collector rings, and high-temperature chemical equipment. We are one of the top Stainless Steel 321 Pipe Fittings manufacturers in India who focus on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

The ASTM A403 WP321h Elbow is used to change the angle of flow in pipelines. These ASTM elbows are advantageous because of their good mechanical properties as well as good performance under extreme temperatures. The WNR NR. 1.4541 Fittings are mostly used in building and chemical industries. They are manufactured with higher creep and stress rupture properties compared to 304 alloys. Our experienced workers use the best raw materials and the latest technology to produce the best products.

The ASME SA 403 WP 321 Pipe Reducer is designed with increased wall thickness. These thick walls provide it more durability as well as resists cracking due to high thermal stress from exhaust gases or rising temperatures. These reducers can be either concentric or eccentric. We also produce the SA403 WP321 Tee, which can be customized into different shapes and sizes to fit pipes or valves of different dimensions. If you have any questions about our products or prices, contact us for more information.

description: Stainless steel forged fittings are high-strength components that are manufactured from a forging process where carbon and iron are alloyed at high temperatures. Forged steel components have a uniform metallurgical recrystallization grain structure. These components are stronger and reliable in terms of shear strength and impact resistance.

What is the difference between Stainless Steel Socket Weld Fittings and fillet weld?
A fillet weld is a common weld in piping fabrication systems. The weld doesn’t require any edge penetration in the piping assembly to weld the modules at an angle of 90 degrees. Stainless steel socket weld fittings are components that are inserted inside a recessed area in a pipe or a valve and welded utilizing a singular fillet weld.

Difference between Hot Forging and Cold Forging Stainless Steel Forged Fittings
Forging is a procedure that allows the metal component to be precisely shaped in definite characteristics. In the hot forging procedure, the metal is heated at high temperatures giving it optimum yield strength, high ductility, and low hardness. Cold Forging is performed at room temperature to enhance the overall strength and hardness of the metal.

Difference between Stainless Steel Forged Elbow and Forged Union
A forged elbow is a fitting that is employed in changing the direction of the flow in the system. Elbows are generally welded or threaded in the pipe module. A forged union is a fitting that is employed in connecting two piping modules without a sealant. The union can be removed later without causing any deformation within the system.

Advantages and Disadvantages of Stainless Steel Forged Fittings
Stainless steel forged fittings are a stronger form of steel and are designed to withstand higher pressures. The process of forging creates a uniform grain flow structure within the components. Designed with higher mechanical properties these modules exhibit enhanced ductility and greater impact resistance. The complex procedure employed in producing these fittings makes them costly. They cannot be employed in producing complex shapes. Apart from this, it has a complex finishing process.

Stainless Steel Npt Fittings are the most popular pressure calibration systems in use. These stainless steel npt fittings depends on a metal-to-metal sealing design. Here the threads in the connectors form together. These connections are advised where there are no changes required in the piping systems. The ASME B16.11 stainless BSP fittings use rounded threads with an angle of 55 degrees. These fittings have been accepted internationally for fitting and sealing piping connections.

The ASTM A182 SS Union and couplings are the most popular forged fitting equipment, which unites two pipes and can be detached without causing any deformations in the piping system. We manufacture all SS Forged Fittings under strict supervision from our experienced and knowledgeable team members. Our team members use the best raw materials using the best technology following international and national standards. If you have any queries about our products, contact us.

description: Stainless steel union fittings are a fitting used to connect pipes that can be unscrewed into 2 separate pieces and screwed back together after both the joints are joined together. This method doesn’t cause as sort of deformation in the piping systems. A normal pipe union consists of 3 parts- a nut, a female, and a male end. This fittings are commonly used in piping systems, water supply, wastewater, fire protection systems, etc. We are the top Stainless Steel Union Fittings manufacturers in India who thrive in producing the best products at reasonable rates.

The SS Compression Union is the most common fitting used in plumbing and electrical conduit systems to join thin-walled pipes together. These fittings are very durable in extreme temperatures and pressures. They are very compatible with aggressive fluids and compression fittings. ASTM A182 Hammer Union is used in flow lines to prevent any leakage in piping systems. These unions can deal with pressures up to 20.000 psi and have material traceability. They are readily used in mud tanks, oil, and gas piping systems. The Stainless Steel Dielectric Union we produce is used in a piping system to slow down corrosion and deterioration caused as a result of galvanization and stray current.

SS Barrel Union is used to allow access for maintenance by breaking the line. The blocking nut is screwed onto a pipe allowing a section of the pipe to be removed for repairing or maintenance. We also produce the 1/2 Npt SS Union that can be customized into different dimensions and shapes as per our client's needs. If you want to know more about our products, or their pricing, contact us

keyword_list: ASTM A182 F304 Push To Connect Tube Fittings

description: Fittings used in various applications are made up of different metals and alloys. Stainless steel is one such material. Stainless Steel Tube Fittings are said to be versatile and are available in austenitic and ferritic types. Austenitic stainless steel fittings are said to be resistant to corrosion. While ferritic stainless steel fittings are said to be magnetic. Stainless Steel Air Line Fittings offer higher strength when compared to untreated stainless steel. The combination of high strength and corrosion resistance allows the wall thickness to be reduced. This material can be recycled and reused at the end of its life and is hence said to be environmentally friendly.

SS 304 High Pressure Tube Fitting has the ability to resist pitting, oxidation, crevice corrosion, and carburization. This is a special chromium and nickel alloy grade that can retain high strength while retaining scaling. They are therefore said to be fire and heat resistant. A low carbon version of this grade of the fitting is the AISI 304L Back Ferrule. The letter ‘L’ suffix to the number denotes the lower amount of carbon. The low carbon content minimizes chromium depletion at grain boundaries and sensitization that would otherwise reduce the corrosion resistance. However, this also makes the fittings structurally weaker than their parent's grade.

ASTM A276 Stainless Steel Push Fit Fittings remove the requirement of annealing the product before completion. Moreover, it assists a swift installation thus making it one of the biggest advantages of using these fittings. They are the easiest way to connect pipes without soldering and welding. SS 316 Front Ferrule Tube eliminates the precipitation in the welding process. The anti corrosion quality is enhanced due to the addition of molybdenum. Weld annealing requires a high stress application. ASTM A182 Pneumatic Fittings are used in pressurized gas systems to connect tubes, hoses, and pipes. They are characterized by low pressure requirements, and tighter seals when compared to hydraulic fittings.

description: Duplex is an austenitic ferrite portion of a mixed microstructure. The Duplex 2205 Pipe Fittings have higher yield strength and good mechanical properties. These fittings are highly resistant to corrosion and stress. The presence of ferritic alloy provides it with strength to prevent cracking in sulfide and chloride environments. Due to these factors, these Saf 2205 Fittings are widely used in oil, gas, petrochemical, and other high pressure and stress-based industries. Over the past decade, we have been the leading manufacturer and supplier of Duplex 2205 Pipe Fittings. Our goal is to produce the best products at the most reasonable rates for all.

The ASME SA 240 UNS S32205 Elbow is a standard elbow, which connects nearly all elbow dimensions. These elbows are available in NPS ½ to NPS 48 and can change the direction flow in pipelines. The UNS S32205 elbows are stronger than austenitic stainless steel. The Duplex 2205 Uns S31803 Stub End is used to create a joint amongst two pipes having backing rings, a fastener set, and a stub gasket. Our experienced staff uses the latest technology while using the best raw materials to produce the best products.

The Duplex Stainless Steel 2205 Tee is made up of a branch diameter, which also has a running pipe diameter of a tee. These tees have 3 female openings which allow them to connect pipes of different diameters. The Duplex Ss 2205 Reducer is used to adapt pipes of different sizes in a piping system. These pipe reducers can be either concentric or eccentric. All our products can be customized into different shapes and sizes, which suit our client’s requirements. description: ASTM A105 comprises of piping components which are made of seamless forged carbon steel. The carbon steel used to produce ASTM A105 Forged Fittings is heated at high temperatures and placed in dies. This is then heated and machined to form these fittings. These fittings are used in pressure systems at high temperatures and are resistant to corrosion in diverse environments. The Astm A105 Threaded Fittings represent the oldest method used to join pipes or valves. These fittings are extremely strong and used in small diameter pipes offering a 37% fatigue strength or higher. We are proudly one of the leading manufacturers of ASTM A105 Forged Fittings. We consider it to be our moral obligation to provide high-quality products at reasonable prices.

The CS A105 Threaded Elbow is installed between pipes to change its direction of flow. These elbows can be attached to the pipe without welding. They are threaded in the bore which allows for it to be rolled on easily to the external thread. The Carbon Steel Grade A105 Union is used in flow lines to prevent any leakage in piping systems. This fitting unites two pipes and can be detached without causing any deformations in the piping system. Our experienced staff uses the latest technology while using the best raw materials whilst creating all our products.

The ASTM A105n Socket Weld Tee is used frequently in small pipes of high pressure. The pipes are inserted in the socket end and a fillet is added around the top to fix the tee through all the openings. The ASTM A105n Socket Weld Tee can be produced in different shapes and directions. These tees are used to combine the flow or divide it as per requirements.

SA 234 Gr WPB Elbow is made from steel pipes. These elbows are used to change the flow of fluids or gases to either 45 or 90 degrees. These elbows can be either short radius or long radius elbows. description: WPL16 fitting refers to a butt-welded product belonging to the ASTM grade. The ASTM A420 WPL6 Fittings covers carbon steel and alloy steel grades. These are used specifically for low-temperature conditions. To ensure it is capable to work under low temperatures the material is arranged in Charpy V tests with temperatures of -46℃. It is mostly used in deep-sea, winter, cold weather, or a few offshore projects. We are the most trusted ASTM A420 WPL6 Fittings manufacturer and suppliers in the country. Our ultimate aim is to produce the best products at reasonable rates.

The LTCS A420 Buttweld Elbow is produced; from steel pipe of grade steel ASTM A333. These elbows are prepared after undergoing vigorous hydrostatic testing and radiographic examinations. We supply long radius as well as short radius elbows. SA 420 WPL6 Pipe Reducer includes concentric and eccentric which reduce the size of the piping they are attached to. The ASTM A420 is available in standard specifications similar to ASTM/ANSI/ASME grades. Our ASME SA420 WPL6 Pipe Fittings can also be customized like all our products in different shapes and dimensions as per your requirements. Our renowned workers use the best technology while using the best raw materials whilst producing the best products in the market.

The LTCS A420 WPL6 Weld Tee is also suited for winter climates. This welding tee undergoes heat treatment immediately after welding. This heat treatment includes tampering, annealing, normalizing, and quenching to obtain a stronger tee. We also produce the ASTM A420 Gr WPL6 Pipe Cap, which helps to protect the pipes or valves during manufacture and transport from physical and environmental damages. If you want to know more about the pricing of our products, contact us.

description: Wrought plate high yield or WPHY fitting is made from carbon-based stainless steel. The Astm A860 Wphy 42 Fittings comprises metals like phosphorous, manganese, vanadium, titanium, silicon, copper, molybdenum, nickel, silicon, and chromium. These fittings have high tensile and mechanical strength. They are also highly corrosion resistant and have yield strength of 415 Mpa. The ASTM A860 WPHY Grade 42 Pipe Fittings show excellent toughness, improved weldability, and resistance to hydrogen cracking induced to due high stress. The WPHY 42 is commonly used in high-pressure applications like gas, oil pipelines, compressor stations, regulating stations, etc. We are one of the leading manufacturers of Astm A860 Wphy 42 Fittings. Our goal is to produce the best products at feasible rates for all.

The Mss Sp75 Wphy 42 Elbow is used in applications where the requirement of corrosion resistance is low. To ensure that they don’t corrode easily however they can be surface treated by coating them with rust-proof black oil or galvanization. The CS WPHY 42 Long Radius Elbow is a popular elbow to change the direction of flow in pipes. These elbows are produced in many dimensions thereby, ensuring a tight seal to prevent any leakage.

The Astm A234 Wphy 42 Tee has 3 female openings forming a T shape. This tee can be reduced to fit pipes of different sizes as per our client’s requirements. We manufacture all our products under strict supervision from our experienced and knowledgeable team members. Our team members use the best raw materials using the best technology while preparing A860 Wphy 42 Buttweld Fittings following international and national standards. description: ASTM A105 comprises of piping components which are made of seamless forged carbon steel. The carbon steel used to produce ASTM A105 Forged Fittings is heated at high temperatures and placed in dies. This is then heated and machined to form these fittings. These fittings are used in pressure systems at high temperatures and are resistant to corrosion in diverse environments. The Astm A105 Threaded Fittings represent the oldest method used to join pipes or valves. These fittings are extremely strong and used in small diameter pipes offering a 37% fatigue strength or higher. We are proudly one of the leading manufacturers of ASTM A105 Forged Fittings. We consider it to be our moral obligation to provide high-quality products at reasonable prices.

The CS A105 Threaded Elbow is installed between pipes to change its direction of flow. These elbows can be attached to the pipe without welding. They are threaded in the bore which allows for it to be rolled on easily to the external thread. The Carbon Steel Grade A105 Union is used in flow lines to prevent any leakage in piping systems. This fitting unites two pipes and can be detached without causing any deformations in the piping system. Our experienced staff uses the latest technology while using the best raw materials whilst creating all our products.

The ASTM A105n Socket Weld Tee is used frequently in small pipes of high pressure. The pipes are inserted in the socket end and a fillet is added around the top to fix the tee through all the openings. The ASTM A105n Socket Weld Tee can be produced in different shapes and directions. These tees are used to combine the flow or divide it as per requirements.

description: Wrought plate high yield or WPHY fitting is made from carbon-based stainless steel. The Astm A860 Wphy 42 Fittings comprises metals like phosphorous, manganese, vanadium, titanium, silicon, copper, molybdenum, nickel, silicon, and chromium. These fittings have high tensile and mechanical strength. They are also highly corrosion resistant and have yield strength of 415 Mpa. The ASTM A860 WPHY Grade 42 Pipe Fittings show excellent toughness, improved weldability, and resistance to hydrogen cracking induced to due high stress. The WPHY 42 is commonly used in high-pressure applications like gas, oil pipelines, compressor stations, regulating stations, etc. We are one of the leading manufacturers of Astm A860 Wphy 42 Fittings. Our goal is to produce the best products at feasible rates for all.

The Mss Sp75 Wphy 42 Elbow is used in applications where the requirement of corrosion resistance is low. To ensure that they don’t corrode easily however they can be surface treated by coating them with rust-proof black oil or galvanization. The CS WPHY 42 Long Radius Elbow is a popular elbow to change the direction of flow in pipes. These elbows are produced in many dimensions thereby, ensuring a tight seal to prevent any leakage.

The Astm A234 Wphy 42 Tee has 3 female openings forming a T shape. This tee can be reduced to fit pipes of different sizes as per our client’s requirements. We manufacture all our products under strict supervision from our experienced and knowledgeable team members. Our team members use the best raw materials using the best technology while preparing A860 Wphy 42 Buttweld Fittings following international and national standards. If you want customized WPHY 42 fittings or want to know more about our products, contact us.

description: WPHY 52 is carbon-based stainless steel. The WPHY 52 Fittings has a high yield strength of above 52000 psi. They are extremely resistant to corrosion due to the presence of molybdenum, nickel, and chromium. These fittings don’t crack when sulfide gas reacts with water in sour service pipelines. They are seen mostly in industries such as chemical refineries, machine apparatuses, engineering, oil, gas, and many other high-pressure industries. The Wphy 52 Buttweld Fittings is treated with heat to obtain high tensile strength. Over the last decade, we have been the leading manufacturer and supplier of Wphy 52 Fittings. We ensure that the products we produce are top quality and available at reasonable rates to all.

The A694 Wphy 52 Elbow is a cost-effective fitting used to change the flow either by 45 or 90 degrees. This durable and tough elbow is highly resistant to any form of erosion. We produce both long and short radius elbows, which can be utilized for high-pressure applications. The Astm A694 Wphy 52 Pipe Fittings can be customized to different shapes and dimensions as per the requirements of our clients.

The A860 Wphy 52 Reducer helps connect one big pipe to a small pipe. These reducers are designed; with increased wall thickness. This provides it with added durability and makes it less prone to cracking under high thermal stress from exhaust gas temperatures. We also produce Mss Sp 75 Wphy 52 Tee, which has 3 openings. This tee can be an equal tee or a reducer tee. This fitting is common in petroleum, gas, and chemical plants. Our staff uses the best raw materials while using the latest technology in preparing all our products. Want to know more contact us.

They are widely seen in marine, oil, gas refining, petrochemical, navy, gas markets, etc. The Astm A860 Wphy 60 Buttweld Fittings is designed to be used in distribution systems and high-pressure transmissions. The A860 Gr Wphy 60 Tee is a common fitting of the WPHY 60 alloy. This tee connects 3 pipes to facilitate the movement of gases or fluids. These fittings can be customized to different shapes and sizes as per your requirements.

The SA860 wphy 60 Concentric Reducer reduces the pipe size in the center and allows the flow in a smooth and simple, way. Our renowned workers use the best Material Wphy 60 and other raw material while preparing all our products using innovative technology. This enables them to produce the best products. This gives it improved mechanical properties and helps them function under extreme conditions. The A860 Wphy 65 Buttweld Fittings have a high yield strength of 415 Mpa besides this it has good elongation and excellent corrosion resistance. These fittings are commonly used in transporting gas, oil along with off-shore and power generation industries. We are the biggest manufactures of A860 WPHY 65 Fittings in the country. Our main aim is to provide the best quality products at reasonable rates.

The Astm A860 Gr Wphy 65 Elbow is highly durable and can withstand extreme pressures. These fittings range from ½ to 24 inches for a nominal diameter in seamless fittings while, they can go up to 120 inches for welded fitting. The A694 Wphy 65 Long Radius Elbow has a radius of curvature 1.5 times the diameter of the pipe. This is the most common elbow and is mostly used for heavy-duty applications. All our products can be customized into different shapes and sizes as per your requirements. Our experienced workers make use of the best raw materials using innovative technology to produce the best products.

The Mss Sp 75 Wphy 65 Tee can be used to deal with any low weight or high weight fluid or gases flowing through it. These tees are used to attach a particular fitting to a stud or divider. The A860 Gr Wphy 65 End cap, on the other hand, is used to protect the pipe from physical or chemical damages. Contact us to know more.

The composition of all these elements gives the Copper Nickel Pipe Fittings good strength and makes fabrication processes easy. These fittings are corrosion resistant and offer good thermal stability along with moderate strength at elevated temperatures. They are used in marine industries, heat exchanger tubes, condensers, oil refineries, etc. The Copper Nickel Buttweld Fittings is composed of 25% nickel and is used to manufacture medals, coins, and other valuable applications. We are the leading manufacturers and suppliers of Copper Nickel Pipe Fittings in the country. Our ultimate aim is to produce the best products at the best prices.

The 70/30 Copper Elbow is made up of 70% copper and 30% nickel. The elbow allows industries to change the direction of the flow of fluids and gases in 3 directions. These elbows are available in NPS ½ to NPS 48. The cupro nickel 90/10 Long Radius Elbow, are standard elbows made up of 90% copper and 10% nickel. These elbows are produced in many dimensions to suit a wide range of applications to ensure a tight seal and preventing any leakage.

The CUNI 90/10 Tee is used to combine or divide fluids through its 3 openings. This tee is available in a female thread, solvent- weld, and opposed solvent-weld sockets. The 90/10 End cap is a protective device to protect pipe ends from moisture, physical damage during transport or manufacturing. Our renowned workers use the best raw materials and the latest technology while producing the best products. We ensure that we use the best raw material while preparing all our products using cutting-edge technology. description: An equal tee is made up of a branch diameter, which is the same as the running pipe diameter of a tee. A tee has 3 female openings forming a T shape. The ASME B16.9 Equal Tee can be used to deal with any low weight or high weight fluid or gases flowing through it. These tees are used to attach a particular fitting to a stud or divider. The Ductile Iron Equal Tee has high tensile strength and ductility. These tees are widely used for the transportation of potable water and in fire systems. We are one of the top manufacturers and distributors of ASME B16.9 Equal Tee, our main focus is creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

The ANSI B16.9 Bsp Buttweld Tee is used in the formation of circumferential butt welds in piping systems. These buttweld tees are used in areas where pipe-work is permanent. They are designed to provide good flow characteristics to either the fluid or gases. The ANSI B16.9 Barred Tee is used pigged in pipelines. There is an internal bar attached to this tee thereby, preventing any traveling down through the branch connection. Our renowned workers ensure that we use the best raw material while using the best technology to produce corrosion resistant and strong products.

In the Carbon Steel Buttweld Reducing Tee, the branch port size is smaller than the other ports of the run. These are common, components of vacuum piping systems. We also specialize in the manufacture of Dn600 Reducing Tee, which can be produced in different dimensions and sizes as per our client's requirements.

The Stainless Steel Sch 40 Concentric Reducers are designed with increased wall thickness. The Black Iron Concentric Reducer reduces the pipe size in the center and allows the flow of gases and fluid in a smooth and simple way. These are widely used to connect black iron to black steel pipes. We can customize our reducers in different shapes and dimensions as per your requirements.

The Cast Iron Eccentric Reducer is specially designed to reduce the pipe to the side. These are referred to as soil pipes and are used in construction, sanitary works, vent piping, etc. The Carbon Steel Eccentric Reducer has a high composition of carbon as compared to other reducers. Our renowned workers produce the best products using the best technology and raw material. Want to know more about our products, and pricing contact us.

meta.keywords: ASME B16.11 Fittings, Ansi B16 11 Fittings, Asme B16.11 Elbow, Asme B16.11 Class 3000, Asme B16 11 Half Coupling, Asme B16.11 Material, Asme B16.11 Threaded Fittings

description: Nearly all manufacturers use standard ASME B16.11 to produce pipe fittings. This standard enables manufacturers in the production of ASME B16.11 Fittings. The ratings, tolerance, dimensions, and raw material requirements gained from the standards help in creating the best products. The ASME B16.11 Material which is used to make forged steel fittings, is used in connecting equipment with pipes and other ASME B16.11 series. The ASME B16.11 Reducing Tee is another fitting of the ASME B16.11 series. This reducing tee has 3 female openings like any other tee. In the reducing tee, however, one of the openings is smaller than the remaining 2. These are commonly used in vacuum piping systems. We are the biggest manufactures of ASME B16.11 Fittings in the country. Our main aim is to provide the best quality products at reasonable rates.

The ANSI B16 11 Threaded Elbow is installed between pipes to change its direction of flow. Threaded elbows represent the oldest method of joining 2 pipes. These are mainly used to join small pipes. These low–cost Ansi B16 11 Fittings are used in domestic water supply, fire protection, and industrial systems. We use the best raw materials to produce the best pipe fittings. The ANSI B16 11 Half Coupling is used in the process of boring a small vessel to a large bore type. The coupling is of two types male and female. In the male coupling, the external threads fit over it while in the female the threads are internal. The piping in the coupling is twisted to secure the connection. These are widely used in aerospace for pressurized fuel piping.

The forming procedure ensures that these fittings are produced of the right dimensions without any imperfections. This invariably means that the Astm A234 Grade WP5 Buttweld Fittings are highly resistant to erosion and corrosion. They are widely used in plumbing, chemical industries, gas, oil, and related industries. We are one of the top ASTM A234 WP5 Fittings manufacturers and suppliers in the country who focus on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

The A234 WP5 Cl1 Reducer offers high tensile strength and provides good durability while joining pipes of different sizes. They are available in concentric and eccentric reducers of both seamless and welded construction. These reducers along with all our, products can be customized into different shapes and sizes as per our client’s requirements. During outdoor excursions, the Alloy Steel WP5 Stub End reduces the rate of attack from atmospheric and artificial sources. This is due to the formation of a sulfate thin protective coat on it. Our renowned workers follow international and national standards whilst using the best raw materials to produce the best products.

The SA234 WP5 End Cap can withstand heavy temperatures and high-temperature conditions and protect the pipe from damage. These caps close the ends of pipes in domestic, commercial, and industrial systems. The Alloy Steel WP5 Elbow allows flexibility and helps change the flow in pipelines. These elbows are used in 3 standard types 90, 45, and 22.5 degrees. If you want to know more about product line contact us.

description: ASTM A234 is a standard pipe fitting material consisting of different kinds of alloy and carbon steels, where WP9 is a grade of pipe. The ASTM A234 WP9 Pipe Fittings is used in high-pressure piping and vessel fabrication system of moderate pressures. These fittings are extremely corrosion resistant. Under extreme temperatures this fittings don’t disintegrate or deform easily. The materials used for ASTM A234 gr WP9 Buttweld Fittings include plates, bars, forged, fusion-welded, seamless, and tubular products. We are the leading supplier and manufacturer of ASTM A234 WP9 Pipe Fittings over the past decade. Our ultimate aim is to produce the best products at reasonable rates for all.

The SA 234 WP9 Reducer can easily bend and can withstand extreme pressures and temperatures. It is widely used to connect pipes of different sizes in petrochemical, chemical, and marine industries. On the other hand, the Alloy Steel Gr WP9 Reducer is designed to deal with low-pressure applications. These reducers can be customized to different shapes and sizes as per your requirements. All our ASTM A234 WP9 Pipe Fittings are produced using the best raw materials with the help of innovative technology.

The ANSI B16.9 Alloy Steel WP9 Elbow is produced following international and national standards. These elbows are grooved, bent, and beveled and can change the flow of fluids and gases. These elbows are available in NPS ½ to NPS 48. The SA234 Wp9 Pipe End cap protects the ends of pipes in pipelines during transportation and production from moisture or any mechanical damage. If you want to know more about our products or pricing, contact us.

description: ASTM A234 WP11 is a standard pipe fitting specification that includes carbon and alloy steel material. The ASTM A234 WP11 Fittings are made from a plate or bar containing 0.35 max carbon. These fittings can be bend or welded easily. The SA234 Gr WP11 Buttweld Fittings are used in high-pressure systems and are extremely resistant to corrosion. These fittings retain their shape at elevated temperatures. These fittings are seen in use in oil, gas, chemical, manufacturing marine, petrochemical, and other related industries. We are the leading manufacturer and supplier of ASTM A234 WP11 Fittings. Our main aim is to produce the best products at reasonable prices.

The ANSI B16.9 Alloy Steel WP11 Elbow is used in high-temperature piping systems to change the flow of gases or fluids. The strength and toughness of the single-piece metal elbow ensure that it doesn’t disintegrate in such conditions. The SA 234 WP11 Reducer help connect pipes of different sizes together. It can be also used when the flow of fluids or gases is expanded or reduced. These pipe reducers can be either concentric or eccentric. All our products are can be customized into different shapes and sizes as per your requirements.

The ASME SA234 Gr WP11 Stub End uses a stub end, which is then welded to a pipe. The stub end is fitted with a ring flange, which allows easy flange alignment in the bolt holes. We follow international and national standards while preparing all our products using cutting-edge technology and the best raw materials. The A234 WP11 Cl1 End cap we produce helps protect the pipe from chemical or natural damage while transportation or production. If you want to know more about our products or pricing contact us.

description: The ASTM A234 is produced in both seamless and welded construction. The ASTM A234 WP22 Fittings is used in applications, which involve pressure piping, and in areas where there are chances of having an ambient or elevated temperature setting. The treatments used in preparing this fitting include annealing, tempering, and normalizing. This fitting is widely seen in petroleum, chemical, construction, shipbuilding, metallurgy, gas, and other related industries. We are proudly one of the leading manufacturers of ASTM A234 WP22 Fittings. We consider it to be our moral obligation to provide high-quality products at reasonable prices.

The Alloy Steel WP22 Elbow has high resistance to corrosion in corrosive environments and oxidations at high temperatures. These elbows are used to change the flow of gases or fluids in high-pressure systems. The A234 WP22 class 3 Elbow is another elbow that is used in piping systems. These high-pressure elbows can be customized into different shapes and sizes as per our client’s requirements. Our exceptional staff performs dimensional and visual inspections of Alloy Steel WP22 CL1 Pipe Fitting to ensure they are the best in town. The tests include ultrasonic, magnetic, hydrostatic, and electromagnetic tests.

The ASME SA234 WP22 Tee is easy to install and has high tensile strength. These tees help connect pipes of equal sizes or different sizes. They help in the uniform flow of fluids or gases in a piping system. The Sa234 Wp22 Stub End consists of 8% chromium with carbon, sulfur, silicon, and molybdenum in its composition. This composition gives it good strength and durability in extreme conditions. All our products are manufactured using the latest technology and the best raw material. Want to know more about our products, our pricing, contact us.

description: ASTM A234 WP91 is a non-magnetic alloy in an annealed condition that can be hardened by cold working. The ASTM A234 WP91 Pipe Fittings have strong welding properties and can be welded onto pipes or valves quite easily. These fittings can withstand extreme pressures in the piping system from various gases and fluids. The ASTM A234 Gr WP91 Buttweld Fittings is low in hardness as a result it performs better for applications that require abrasive resistance and have low corrosion resistance properties. These fittings are widely used in chemical, oil, gas, power plants, etc. We are proudly one of the top ASTM A234 WP91 Pipe Fittings manufacturers and suppliers in India who focuses on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

The Alloy Steel WP91 Elbow is used to reduce the formation of carbide precipitation in heavier heat-affected regions, which are adjacent to the weld pool. These elbows play a pivotal role in changing the direction of flow in this pipelines. The SA234 WP91 Tee has 3 openings to attach these pipes. These tees are available either as reducing or as equal tees. We manufacture all our products under strict supervision from our experienced and knowledgeable team members. Our team members use the best raw materials using the best technology following international and national standards.

The Sa234 Wp91 Reducer connects pipes of different sizes. It is also used in stainless and decorative work for household appliances. We also manufacture the ANSI.B16.9 Alloy Steel WP91 Tee, which like our other products; can be customized into different shapes and sizes as per your requirements. If you want to find out more about our products, you can contact us to get more information regarding them.

description: ASTM A234 WP5 is made up of alloy steel. The ASTM A234 WP5 Fittings are used in piping systems focused on supporting elevated temperatures and pressures. These fittings are formed at elevated temperatures followed by annealing and followed by cooling. The forming procedure ensures that these fittings are produced of the right dimensions without any imperfections. This invariably means that the Astm A234 Grade WP5 Buttweld Fittings are highly resistant to erosion and corrosion. They are widely used in plumbing, chemical industries, gas, oil, and related industries. We are one of the top ASTM A234 WP5 Fittings manufacturers and suppliers in the country who focus on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

The A234 WP5 Cl1 Reducer offers high tensile strength and provides good durability while joining pipes of different sizes. They are available in concentric and eccentric reducers of both seamless and welded construction. These reducers along with all our, products can be customized into different shapes and sizes as per our client’s requirements. During outdoor excursions, the Alloy Steel WP5 Stub End reduces the rate of attack from atmospheric and artificial sources. This is due to the formation of a sulfate thin protective coat on it. Our renowned workers follow international and national standards whilst using the best raw materials to produce the best products.

The SA234 WP5 End Cap can withstand heavy temperatures and high-temperature conditions and protect the pipe from damage. These caps close the ends of pipes in domestic, commercial, and industrial systems. The Alloy Steel WP5 Elbow allows flexibility and helps change the flow in pipelines. These elbows are used in 3 standard types 90, 45, and 22.5 degrees. If you want to know more about product line contact us.

description: ASTM A234 is a standard pipe fitting material consisting of different kinds of alloy and carbon steels, where WP9 is a grade of pipe. The ASTM A234 WP9 Pipe Fittings is used in high-pressure piping and vessel fabrication system of moderate pressures. These fittings are extremely corrosion resistant. Under extreme temperatures this fittings don’t disintegrate or deform easily. The materials used for ASTM A234 gr WP9 Buttweld Fittings include plates, bars, forged, fusion-welded, seamless, and tubular products. We are the leading supplier and manufacturer of ASTM A234 WP9 Pipe Fittings over the past decade. Our ultimate aim is to produce the best products at reasonable rates for all.

The SA 234 WP9 Reducer can easily bend and can withstand extreme pressures and temperatures. It is widely used to connect pipes of different sizes in petrochemical, chemical, and marine industries. On the other hand, the Alloy Steel Gr WP9 Reducer is designed to deal with low-pressure applications. These reducers can be customized to different shapes and sizes as per your requirements. All our ASTM A234 WP9 Pipe Fittings are produced using the best raw materials with the help of innovative technology.

The ANSI B16.9 Alloy Steel WP9 Elbow is produced following international and national standards. These elbows are grooved, bent, and beveled and can change the flow of fluids and gases. These elbows are available in NPS ½ to NPS 48. The SA234 Wp9 Pipe End cap protects the ends of pipes in pipelines during transportation and production from moisture or any mechanical damage. If you want to know more about our products or pricing, contact us.

description: ASTM A234 WP11 is a standard pipe fitting specification that includes carbon and alloy steel material. The ASTM A234 WP11 Fittings are made from a plate or bar containing 0.35 max carbon. These fittings can be bend or welded easily. The SA234 Gr WP11 Buttweld Fittings are used in high-pressure systems and are extremely resistant to corrosion. These fittings retain their shape at elevated temperatures. These fittings are seen in use in oil, gas, chemical, manufacturing marine, petrochemical, and other related industries. We are the leading manufacturer and supplier of ASTM A234 WP11 Fittings. Our main aim is to produce the best products at reasonable prices.

The ANSI B16.9 Alloy Steel WP11 Elbow is used in high-temperature piping systems to change the flow of gases or fluids. The strength and toughness of the single-piece metal elbow ensure that it doesn’t disintegrate in such conditions. The SA 234 WP11 Reducer help connect pipes of different sizes together. It can be also used when the flow of fluids or gases is expanded or reduced. These pipe reducers can be either concentric or eccentric. All our products are can be customized into different shapes and sizes as per your requirements.

The ASME SA234 Gr WP11 Stub End uses a stub end, which is then welded to a pipe. The stub end is fitted with a ring flange, which allows easy flange alignment in the bolt holes. We follow international and national standards while preparing all our products using cutting-edge technology and the best raw materials. The A234 WP11 Cl1 End cap we produce helps protect the pipe from chemical or natural damage while transportation or production. If you want to know more about our products or pricing contact us.

description: The ASTM A234 is produced in both seamless and welded construction. The ASTM A234 WP22 Fittings is used in applications, which involve pressure piping, and in areas where there are chances of having an ambient or elevated temperature setting. The treatments used in preparing this fitting include annealing, tempering, and normalizing. This fitting is widely seen in petroleum, chemical, construction, shipbuilding, metallurgy, gas, and other related industries. We are proudly one of the leading manufacturers of ASTM A234 WP22 Fittings. We consider it to be our moral obligation to provide high-quality products at reasonable prices.

The Alloy Steel WP22 Elbow has high resistance to corrosion in corrosive environments and oxidations at high temperatures. These elbows are used to change the flow of gases or fluids in high-pressure systems. The A234 WP22 class 3 Elbow is another elbow that is used in piping systems. These high-pressure elbows can be customized into different shapes and sizes as per our client’s requirements. Our exceptional staff performs dimensional and visual inspections of Alloy Steel WP22 CL1 Pipe Fitting to ensure they are the best in town. The tests include ultrasonic, magnetic, hydrostatic, and electromagnetic tests.

The ASME SA234 WP22 Tee is easy to install and has high tensile strength. These tees help connect pipes of equal sizes or different sizes. They help in the uniform flow of fluids or gases in a piping system. The Sa234 Wp22 Stub End consists of 8% chromium with carbon, sulfur, silicon, and molybdenum in its composition. This composition gives it good strength and durability in extreme conditions. All our products are manufactured using the latest technology and the best raw material. Want to know more about our products, our pricing, contact us.

description: Inconel is a nickel-chromium alloy that has additions of aluminum. The nickel present in Inconel 600 Fittings gives it excellent resistance to corrosion and good oxidation resistance at higher temperatures. The chromium in this compound provides resistance to sulfur compounds in different oxidizing environments. These fittings also have good tensile strength, workability and can be welded easily. They are widely seen in use in heat exchangers, combustion cans, tubing, piping, liners, condensers, furnaces, aerospace industries, and similar related industries. We are proud to be the leading manufacturers of Inconel 600 Fittings, and our ultimate aim is to produce high-quality products at reasonable rates.

The ASTM B366 UNS N06600 Elbow is used in changing the flow of fluids and gases in a piping system. These elbows can work under extreme temperatures in food and chemical processing industries. Also, these elbows can be cold worked 649 degrees C in extreme situations. The DIN 2.4816 Stub End is made up using buttweld fittings, which can be used with a lap joint. This stub end has a tensile strength of about 95,000 Psi along with good elongation properties. All our products are manufactured using the latest technology with the use of the best raw materials.

During production and transportation, pipes need to be protected. The 600 Inconel End Cap is used to protect pipes from damage due to moisture or physical damage while moving from place to place. The Nickel 600 Pipe Cap is used to stop the flow of fluids at the end of the pipe. These caps protect pipe threads and are used to direct flow to a particular end. In the Alloy 600 Reducing Tee the branch, port size is smaller than the other ports of the run. Want to know more about our products contact us.

description: Monel 400 is made up of nickel and copper along with trace elements comprising of iron, manganese, carbon, and silicon. Monel 400 Fittings has excellent resistance against acids and alkalis thereby, being extremely corrosion resistant. Along with this, it has good tensile strength, thermal conductivity, and has elongation properties. After hardening these fittings with cold-working they are suitable to work at temperatures from sub-zero to 538°C. These fittings are commonly found in valves, pumps, heat exchangers, marine engineering, chemical, and hydrocarbon processing units. We are the leading manufacturers and suppliers of Monel 400 Fittings. We consider it our moral obligation to produce high-quality products at reasonable rates.

The Alloy 400 Reducer fitting changes the pipe size from a large bore to a small one. The hydraulic flow reduction in the system helps the pipe in adapting to different sizes of pipes. These pipe reducers can be either concentric or eccentric. UNS N04400 Stub End is used to create a joint amongst two pipes having backing rings, a fastener set, and a stub gasket. Our experienced staff uses the latest technology while using the best raw materials to produce the best products.

The ASTM B366 UNS N04400 Buttweld Elbow is fitted between two pipes or tubes, which, helps to change the direction of flow of that pipe or tube. These elbows come as either short-radius elbows or long-radius elbows. The ASTM B366 UNS N04400 Long Radius Elbow is the most commonly used elbow amongst the two. If you want to know more about our products or pricing, contact us.

description: Fittings made up of a variety of metals and alloys are available in the market. One such fitting is the Brass Fitting. They are used in various industries due to their ability to withstand high temperatures, resist corrosion, as well as abrasion. Since brass is a durable material the fittings made out of it also offer this advantage. Once installed they remain in the same condition for several years. Brass Inverted Flared Fittings are used in hydraulic brake, and power steering. They are said to be versatile and enhance the efficiency of the water delivery system. They are available in nickel finished, chrome plated, or polished.

ASTM B16 Brass Compression Fittings are aesthetically attractive. and malleable. It is easy to bend, mold, or weld them. Due to this, there is the ease of installation and the cost is also reduced. They are not vulnerable to wear and tear as they are resistant to corrosion and rust. C2600 Brass Tee is used to connect 3 different pipes. They are widely used for ammunition, decorative furniture parts, and components. They are generally available in natural finish or nickel plated. However, they can be customized and coated as per the customer's specific requirements. ASTM B283 Compression Elbow, brass male connector, brass nut, brass sleeve, and nuts are few examples of these fittings.

Red Brass C23000 Ferrule Union can resist a working pressure of up to 2000 PSI and a operating temperature range of 65 degrees F to 250 degrees F. one of the advantages of these fittings is that they cost less and do not require tube flaring. They are used in hydraulic pneumatic systems, and in instrumentations. Moreover, Brass Transmission Fittings are also used for carrying chemicals, water, flammable gases, and slurries. Generally, they last for 80 to 100 years. We have been supplying these fittings to various customers in different industries at affordable prices without compromising on quality.
